grounding.exactText: Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with over 10,000 entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals in over 40 countries.
grounding.subject: COMPANY

grounding.exactText: We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential.
grounding.subject: COMPANY

grounding.exactText: Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry.
grounding.subject: COMPANY

grounding.exactText: The collaborative environment and engaging work-guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity - are why our people love working at A&M.The Team
grounding.subject: COMPANY

grounding.exactText: Data & Applied Intelligence - Helping clients in harnessing the power of data and cutting-edge analytics to drive intelligent decision-making and transform businesses
grounding.subject: COMPANY

grounding.exactText: Product and Innovation - Empowering clients to innovate, develop, and launch products that drives growth and competitive advantage
grounding.subject: COMPANY

grounding.exactText: Technology M&A and Strategy - Assist clients to manage the technology aspects and business enablement of complex M&A, integrations and carve-outs
grounding.subject: COMPANY

grounding.exactText: Technology Transformation - A&M helps clients create a scalable, cost-effective IT function that delivers the company's strategic vision and priorities.
grounding.subject: COMPANY

grounding.exactText: The Change Manager will play a critical role in enabling end to end change management for Digital & Technology initiatives across A&M client engagements.
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: Sitting within DTS, this role partners closely with technology, data, AI, and business teams to translate complex digital transformations into practical, adoptable change - driving value realization and sustained outcomes.
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: Sitting within DTS, this role partners closely with technology, data, AI, and business teams to translate complex digital transformations into practical, adoptable change - driving value realization and sustained outcomes.
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: This role is particularly relevant to A&M’s growing work across enterprise digital transformation, AI-led solutions, platform modernization, and technology-enabled operating model changes
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: Lead end-to-end change management for DTS-led transformations, including digital platforms, analytics, AI solutions, and operating model redesigns Embed change management into tech delivery lifecycles, ensuring adoption is planned alongside build, not post-implementation
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: Act as the bridge between business, technology, and leadership, translating technical change into business-relevant narratives Enable Digital & AI-Driven Adoption
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: Support adoption of AI-enabled tools and digital solutions such as intelligent workflows, agentic or decision-support systems
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: Design user-centric adoption strategies covering communications, enablement, risk management, and behavioural change
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: Partner with product owners and tech teams to ensure solutions are usable, explainable, and responsibly adopted Stakeholder & Leadership Engagement
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: Partner with client leadership, DTS engagement leads, and internal stakeholders to shape change strategies aligned to value and outcomes
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: Develop leadership-ready materials (change roadmaps, adoption dashboards, rollout approaches) tailored to senior audiences Operating Model & Capability Change
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: Support digital operating model shifts, including ways of working, role changes, governance, and capability uplift
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: Design practical enablement approaches that help business users work differently from Day 1 Measurement & Sustainment
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: Define and track adoption and change metrics tied to business value, not just activity completion
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: Define and track adoption and change metrics tied to business value, not just activity completion
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: Put in place sustainment mechanisms to ensure changes hold post go-live Skills & Capabilities (Must-Have) Change & Transformation5–10 years of experience in Change Management, preferably in technology-led or digital transformation programs
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: Put in place sustainment mechanisms to ensure changes hold post go-live Skills & Capabilities (Must-Have) Change & Transformation5–10 years of experience in Change Management, preferably in technology-led or digital transformation programs
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: Strong grounding in change frameworks (Prosci, ADKAR, or equivalent) with the ability to apply pragmatically, not theoretically Digital & Technology Orientation
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: Proven experience working with DTS, Digital, Data, or Technology teams
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: Strong comfort engaging with technical concepts (digital platforms, AI, automation, analytics) and translating them for business audiences
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: Experience integrating change into agile / product-based delivery models Stakeholder & Consulting Skills
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: Consulting-grade communication and storytelling skills, especially for leadership and senior stakeholders
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: Ability to operate in complex, fast-moving, ambiguous environments typical of A&M engagements
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: Strong facilitation, problem-solving, and influencing skills
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: Exposure to Tech-enabled M&A (technology separation, integration, or value creation) Experience supporting adoption of AI, GenAI, or Agentic AQualifications
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: Master’s degree in business, Change Management, Organizational Psychology, HR, Technology Management, or a related field
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: Change certifications (Prosci, APMG, etc.) preferred but not mandatory
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: Prior experience in consulting or transformation-heavy environments strongly preferred
grounding.subject: ROLE

grounding.exactText: Your journey at A&M We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development.
grounding.subject: COMPANY

grounding.exactText: Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy.
grounding.subject: COMPANY

grounding.exactText: With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career.
grounding.subject: COMPANY

grounding.exactText: We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey.
grounding.subject: COMPANY

grounding.exactText: Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.
grounding.subject: COMPANY
